scope: Production authoring: 15 handcrafted levels; exhaustive reachable group settings with the production simulator.

name: All Aboard
準備出發
levels.difficulty: One independent switch. Read its selected connection; distinguish station from a visibly blocked siding.

name: Two Decisions
兩次選擇
levels.difficulty: Two independent switches in sequence. The first selects continuation, the second distinguishes the station branch from works.

name: Scenic Route
沿途風景
levels.difficulty: A visibly blocked shortcut invites inspection of a long route. Four curves establish continuous, inspectable port geometry.

name: Around We Go
繞呀繞
levels.difficulty: A real reversible cycle with a selectable escape. Starting heading is internal and explicit; the wrong setting has a solver-detected nonproductive loop.

name: Junction Master
轉轍大師
levels.difficulty: Chapter-one synthesis: a cycle, a second independent decision and a visibly obstructed siding. Escaping the loop alone is insufficient.

name: Riverbend
河畔彎道
levels.difficulty: A misleading straight siding contrasts with a long northern detour and a second switch near the destination. Two independent decisions, longer physical inspection.

name: Read the Points
看懂轉轍器
levels.difficulty: Both junctions are approached from their selected branches, exercising reverse traversal and rejecting branch-to-branch shortcuts.

name: Post Before Parcels
先郵件，後包裹
levels.difficulty: The short path reaches the second required stop first. Correctly connected switches can therefore fail on objective order, not just connectivity.

name: A Second Look
再看一眼
levels.difficulty: Objective-aware loop detection: the wrong configuration makes objective progress before revisiting rails; only a repeated complete directed state fails. An ordinary station is pass-through.

name: The Valley Round
山谷巡禮
levels.difficulty: Chapter-two synthesis: four independent switches, a blocked branch, a tempting premature terminus and three ordered stops along a long outer route.

name: Better Together
一起轉動
levels.difficulty: Introduces one clearly marked two-member mechanical group. The same transaction opens the northern detour and the station approach.

name: Opposite Signals
相反的號誌
levels.difficulty: Opposite initial phases in a linked pair, selected-branch entry, and a visibly blocked central cross-connection. The group is atomic but its members face different ways.

name: Two in Tandem
兩組默契
levels.difficulty: Two independent linked groups with different phases. Four visible junctions affect two decisions, ordered deliveries and a blocked internal connection.

name: Shared Horizons
共同的遠方
levels.difficulty: Three-member atomic linkage plus an independent exit, reverse stem traversal and three ordered objectives. Compass directions differ within the shared group.

name: The Grand Junction
鐵道大團圓
levels.difficulty: Final synthesis: five junctions, two linked phases and an independent ring exit; three ordered stops; a visibly blocked central branch; wrong full-state cycles after objective progress.
